purpose: Add a more striking fact to an already notable one.
keywords: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + ばかりか
This shop is not only inexpensive; delivery is free too.
He not only failed to apologize but blamed me.
My grandmother speaks not only English but Chinese too.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveな + ばかりか
restrictions: The second clause escalates or broadens the first.
mistake: Use an additive relationship, not an unrelated contrast.
